notes: The waw of וּלְמַדְתֶּם is rendered by the connective that; rule 14 reads the connective off the ASV rather than a fixed list.
Both object markers on the coordinated nouns are unrepresented; the ASV writes the objects bare (rule 16).
הַיּוֹם writes one determiner, this, which the article takes under rule 41.
